BRILEYTOKYO GHOUL · BREAK THE CHAINS · ACCOUNT PLAN

CP 2,495,218 · Free-to-play · roster updated 2026-11-06 · guide 2026-11-12

Guild War: updated 2026-11-10

  • Changed Nov 10: the game now puts defenders on empty tiles, so 1–2 unit "tile teams" no longer work. The solo push to the Core also failed: the center team died. No team is proven immortal yet.
  • Take every T1 and building around our base first, then the Gates and T2s.
  • Garrison each building as soon as you take it.
  • Only hit the Core once our buildings are taken and garrisoned.
  • Nobody goes for the Core alone. The solo "immortal" push died.

Your 3 teams: Strike (strongest), Second strike (next-best FULL team), Wall (garrisons what we take). No more 1–2 unit tile teams.

Do this now

  1. Main team: Hinami Fueguchi [Halloween] · Toka [Maid Costume] · Hinami [Hina Matsuri] · Toka [June Bride], Roma [Mad Clown] back-up.
  2. Crystals: Toka [June Bride] 3★ → Roma [Mad Clown] 1★ → Hinami Fueguchi [Halloween] 3★ (check the item accepts each unit).
  3. Chase later: Juzo [False Girl], Ayato [1.5th Anniversary], Akira [June Bride].
